items.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
items.description: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

items.title: James Talarico becomes first Democrat to win Texas Senate seat since 1988
items.description: "This wasn't just a tsunami, not just a referendum, but this was a bloodbath," one expert told the BBC on Democrats' historic wins in Texas.

items.title: Left-wing Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins in Michigan to become first Muslim senator
items.description: El-Sayed bested Republican Mike Rogers to become the first Muslim senator in US history.

items.title: Florida Republicans fend off Democrats as state elects first black governor
items.description: Republican Byron Donalds, who was backed by President Donald Trump, will be the first black governor of Florida.

items.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
items.description: "We endorse this message," Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf says, as Donald Trump acknowledges the conflict's role in the Republican Party's defeat.

items.title: Zelensky gives Melania Trump Ukraine's highest award after Oleshky ceasefire
items.description: Russian and Ukrainian delegations will meet the US first lady at the White House on Thursday.

items.title: Delhi air quality worsens ahead of Diwali as firework restrictions enter force
items.description: On Wednesday morning, Delhi's air quality index reading stood at 377, in the "very poor" category.

items.title: Nadal set to join Real Madrid board of directors
items.description: Tennis great Rafael Nadal is set to join the board of Spanish football giants Real Madrid.

items.title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
items.description: As South Africans vote in local elections, residents tell the BBC they are tired of the poor quality of services they get.

items.title: Sharp objects found in Halloween sweets in three European nations
items.description: Dozens of cases are reported in Austria, Germany and Hungary, including a nine-year-old girl hurting her tongue while eating chocolate containing a pin.

items.title: Rwanda's army team removed from Africa league after US sanctions, NBA says
items.description: The US imposed sanctions on Rwanda's army over its role in the conflict in DR Congo.

items.title: Mother of Ghanaian boy killed in US 'wants justice' as she flies for funeral
items.description: Police have not made any arrests and an investigation is ongoing as authorities search for three teenage boys.
